segments.name: Biopharmaceutical Royalties
segments.description: Acquires royalties on marketed and development-stage biopharmaceutical therapies, collecting payments based on the top-line sales of products commercialized by other companies.
segments.evidence: As such, we concluded that we operate as one single reportable segment, which is primarily focused on acquiring biopharmaceutical royalties.

revenueModel.text: Biopharmaceutical companies and other royalty holders pay us royalties based directly on the top-line sales of the therapies whose royalty rights we acquire.
revenueModel.evidence: The royalties in our portfolio entitle us to payments based directly on the top-line sales of the associated therapies, rather than the profits of these therapies.
